questions.text: docs/techstack.md still lists the frontend framework as 'Not Yet Specified'. Which framework should web-ui use for the onboarding form, hospital profile and Super Admin alert screens (e.g. React, Angular, Vue, Next.js)?

The Requirement also needs backend work: saving the form, locking the counts, logging Super Admin corrections, calculating yearly averages, and the 2x/3x alert checks. The only application is web-ui. Should this Work Item cover both the UI and the backend, or only the web-ui screens (with the backend as a separate Work Item/application)? If it includes the backend, which runtime/language should the microservices use (not yet specified in techstack.md)?

The form is filled in at first sign-up, but the auth mechanism is 'Not Yet Specified' in techstack.md. How does the tenant create their login: email + password, phone OTP, Google sign-in, or something else? And is creating the login part of this Work Item?
questions.answer: not needed here, it is separate feature, which will be built separately later in RBAC

questions.text: The data store is a per-tenant web-based SQLite database. Where should the onboarding form data and baseline counts be stored: in a platform-level (Super Admin) database, or in the new tenant's own database created at sign-up? Super Admin alerts need to read across all tenants.
questions.answer: Dont worry about multi tenancy right now

questions.text: How often should the 2x/3x alert check run: each time a delivery/USG/NICU/LSCS event is recorded, or as a scheduled job (e.g. daily)? And how should the Super Admin receive alerts: an in-app alert list only, or also email/SMS?
techstack.md says 'web-based SQLite, per-tenant database'. Which SQLite option is meant: a SQLite file on the server via better-sqlite3, libSQL/Turso, Cloudflare D1, or other?

The blueprint has separate microservices (Tenant Provisioning, Subscription, Notification), but apps/backend is currently one Express app. Should this work go into apps/backend as separate modules/routes per service for now, or be set up as its own service?
The registration certificate upload goes to the Firebase document store. Is a Firebase project already set up with credentials available, or should this Work Item stub the upload for now?
